title: Sweet Herby Double Haloumi & Carrot Couscous Bowl
subtitle: with Garlic Yoghurt
description: Less is more with this stripped back veggie delight! Enjoy herby, honey haloumi slices teamed with a delicate carrot couscous and vibrant salad. Don’t forget a generous drizzle of garlic yoghurt for a welcome hint of creaminess and tang.

steps.text:
• In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak.
• Finely chop or crush garlic. Grate carrot.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil and 1/2 the garlic over medium-high heat. Cook until fragrant, 1 min.
• Transfer garlic oil to a small heatproof bowl, then stir in yoghurt. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

• In a medium saucepan, melt the butter with a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook 1/2 the carrot, stirring, until softened, 2-3 mins.
• Add the water and stock powder and bring to the boil.
• Stir in couscous. Cover and remove from heat. Set aside until water is absorbed, 5 mins. Fluff up with a fork.

• Drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.
• Return frying pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil and cook haloumi until golden brown, 1-2 mins each side. Cook in batches if your pan is getting crowded.
• Remove from heat, add the honey and dried oregano (see ingredients) and turn to coat.

• In a medium bowl, toss salad leaves and remaining carrot with a drizzle of vinegar and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
• Divide carrot couscous and salad between bowls.
• Top with sweet herby haloumi and drizzle over garlic yoghurt to serve.
